---
title: "PCA accuracy against the exact reference"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
files <- readLines("inputs.txt")
m <- rbindlist(lapply(files, fread), fill = TRUE)
m <- m[is_reference == FALSE]
m[, input := paste(norm, feat, sep = " / ")]
# log axes: exact agreement is 0, show it at the double-precision floor
floor_ <- 1e-16
m[, shown := pmax(value, floor_)]
```

Every PCA arm is compared with `pc_exact` (scanpy, dense LAPACK SVD, float64)
computed on **the same** `normalized_selected` matrix: same dataset, NORM and
FEAT branch. Sines come from projection residuals, so values down to ~1e-15
are real. NMF factors are neither orthogonal nor ordered by variance: read only
their subspace rows.

`r m[, uniqueN(pca)]` PCA modules, `r m[, uniqueN(input)]` input matrices,
`r m[, uniqueN(dataset)]` dataset(s), from `r length(files)` metric table(s).

## Summary

```{r}
s <- m[, .(
  `max pc_sin, PC1-10` = max(value[metric == "pc_sin" & index <= 10]),
  `subspace_sin k=10` = value[metric == "subspace_sin" & index == 10][1],
  `subspace_sin k=50` = value[metric == "subspace_sin" & index == 50][1],
  `max eig_rel_err, PC1-10` = max(value[metric == "eig_rel_err" & index <= 10])
), by = .(dataset, pca, pca_params, input)]
setorder(s, dataset, pca, input)
knitr::kable(s, digits = 3, format.args = list(scientific = TRUE))
```

## Per-PC loading error

sin(angle) between each PC's loading vector and the reference's. Rising error
at high PCs is expected where the eigengap closes (PCs below the noise edge).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
ggplot(m[metric == "pc_sin"], aes(index, shown, colour = pca, group = interaction(pca, pca_params))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~input) +
  labs(x = "PC", y = "sin(angle) to reference", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Leading-subspace error

Largest principal-angle sine between the leading k loadings (solid) and cell
scores (dashed) of each arm and the reference.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
sub <- m[metric %in% c("subspace_sin", "scores_sin")]
ggplot(sub, aes(index, shown, colour = pca, linetype = metric,
                group = interaction(pca, pca_params, metric))) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~input) +
  labs(x = "k (leading PCs)", y = "max sin(principal angle)", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Eigenvalue error

Relative error of each PC's score variance against the reference eigenvalue.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
ggplot(m[metric == "eig_rel_err"], aes(index, shown, colour = pca, group = interaction(pca, pca_params))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~input) +
  labs(x = "PC", y = "relative eigenvalue error", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```
